_comment: Single source of truth for the third-party libraries vendored under
geoengine/static/lib. Deliberately the same shape as
tooling/assets/check_vendored_libs.py checks versions and artifact hashes;
geoengine/machine_doc_v1/factcheck.sh also checks this tree's declarations.
'probe' locates the version inside the vendored tree: 'file' is relative
to the library directory and 'pattern' is a Python regex in which the
tokens {version} and {source_sha256} are replaced by their escaped pins.
All four are ES modules resolved through the browser import map. The
bare specifier each one answers to is declared by geoengine's own
__manifest__.py under the 'esm.external_libs' key, and restated as
'specifier' in each entry below. See README.md in this directory.

ol.notes: NOT a pristine upstream file. The npm package ships ~1100 separate modules and no single-file ESM bundle; its dist/ol.js is a legacy global build, which is what geoengine used until this version. build.sh bundles entry.js with a pinned esbuild, and entry.js is the inventory of the 62 symbols the fork uses -- tree-shaking drops the rest, which is why the shipped file is 677 KB against the 1043 KB full dist. Adding a symbol to entry.js is the only thing that grows it. Consumed by geoengine and device_gps_geoengine.

chroma-js.notes: Single-file ESM build of the package's default entry point. The package is native ESM but ships as a source tree, so it is bundled for the same reason ol is: an import-map external must resolve to one URL. The full entry is deliberate -- the ./light subpath drops the colour-brewer palettes and geoengine_model.js calls chroma.scale('RdYlBu'), which would then fail at runtime rather than at build time.

proj4.notes: Single-file ESM build of the package's default entry point (the package's own version string is an unreplaced __VERSION__ placeholder, so the probe reads build.sh). Loaded only by a map that needs a CRS OpenLayers does not resolve itself (anything but EPSG:4326, EPSG:3857 and the UTM zones): geo_libs.registerProjections imports it and hands it to ol.proj.register with the definitions get_layers sends from PostGIS's spatial_ref_sys.

geostats.notes: Version verified against the npm 2.1.0 tarball: its lib/geostats.js matches the shipped executable AST after replacing the UMD wrapper with an ESM IIFE and default export, correcting the missing translation helper t() to _t(), and declaring the four legend temporaries required by strict mode. source_sha256 identifies the upstream file; checksums pins the shipped artifact. Keep the source readable and reapply all four AgroMarin: markers when replacing it. The version/source banner and checksum bind that reviewed source to its manifest pin.
